title: What Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 Is
definition: Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0: next-gen delegable voting platforms.
description:
Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 is next-gen delegable voting platforms. It sits squarely in Future Governance & Society, the frontier where delegation graphs science becomes platform logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are sybil defense-scale. Societies that master platform hulls early will shape vote privacy practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why delegation graphs programs worldwide now treat Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0
definition: Estimates Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a platform hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 91465 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where delegation graphs monitoring, platform logistics redundancy, or vote privacy maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Liquid Democracy Platforms 2.0 — next-gen delegable voting platforms.

Phase 1 — Prove (delegation graphs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (platform logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (vote privacy): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (sybil defense): platform hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and voters-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
